title: Xie content file
description: One definition file in a Xie content pack. Add "$schema": "../xie-content.schema.json" (or wherever this file lives relative to yours) at the top of a definition file to get completion and validation in an editor. Keys are matched case-insensitively by the engine; this schema lists the canonical spelling. Numbers may be written as JSON numbers or as quoted strings, and comma-separated lists may be written as one string or as a JSON array. Unknown properties are allowed everywhere, because archetypes can be added by other mods, but the engine reports every property no archetype consumed.

version.description: Ignored. Older files carried a format version here.

texturePaths.description: Where a spritesheet named in a texFile lives, relative to the pack's textures/ directory.

^_.description: Any key starting with an underscore is skipped. Use it to comment a file ("_comment"), disable a whole section ("_blocks"), or note what a file depends on ("_requires").

int.description: An integer, as a number or a quoted number.

number.description: A number, as a number or a quoted number.

boolean.description: A boolean. true/false, "true"/"false", "yes"/"no", or a number where zero is false.

itemRef.description: A reference to an item or block. "tomato" names a Xie item or block; "farming@tomato" qualifies it by the file it was declared in; "tile.melon" or "item.melon" is a vanilla block or item by its legacy unlocalised name; ":4" appends a stack count and ":1:3" a count and a metadata value; "$name" is an alias declared in an aliases section; "#name" is a built-in group the engine supplies.

refList.description: Item references, comma-separated in one string or as an array. A bare number is a legacy numeric block id, e.g. 0 for air.

intList.description: Integers, one per subtype: a single integer, a comma-separated string, or an array.

stringList.description: Names, comma-separated in one string or as an array.

metaRangePattern.description: A key naming which metadata (growth stage, damage value) an entry applies to: a single value "3", an inclusive range "0-2", or an open range "6+".

metaInt.description: An integer that may vary by metadata: one value for every state, or an object keyed by metadata range.

bounds.description: A collision box as six numbers, "minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ", in block units from 0 to 1.

metaBounds.description: A collision box, uniform or keyed by metadata range: {"0-2": "0,0,0,1,0.1875,1", "6+": "0,0,0,1,1,1"}.

drop.description: One entry of a drop table. A bare number is the amount; an object gives a percentage chance, optionally per metadata range, an amount, and how many of that amount are guaranteed.

chance.description: Percent chance to drop, 0 to 100, uniform or keyed by metadata range (for a crop, its growth stage).

amount.description: How many at most: independent rolls at chance, not a stack size. Default 1.

min.description: How many of amount drop without a roll, wherever chance is above zero; the rest are rolled. Default 0.

dropTable.description: What something yields. Either a comma-separated list of item references that always drop, or an object from item reference to chance and amount.

tex.description: Spritesheet indices per face. Face names: all, sides, ends, top, bottom, front, back, north, south, east, west, icon. Each is an index into texFile, uniform or keyed by metadata range.

texFile.description: Spritesheet file name under the pack's textures/ directory, e.g. "xie_crops.png".

textureBase.description: Reuse another block's textures instead of a spritesheet, e.g. "crops" for vanilla wheat.

blockSection.description: Blocks, keyed by the name other definitions refer to them by.

blockType.description: The archetype that decides how the block behaves. Anything not listed needs another mod to register it.

block.description: A block. The properties below apply to every archetype the engine registers; the allOf branches add the ones each archetype reads, keyed on the lower-case type (no type means basic). A property outside its archetype's branches is still accepted, and the engine reports it as unread.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the key.

override.description: Replace an existing block, named by reference, with this definition.

hardness.description: Time to break. Zero breaks instantly.

fuel.description: Burn time in ticks when used as furnace fuel. Only a block with an item form, a sapling or one that drops itself, can burn.

cooked.description: The item this block's item form smelts into: a furnace recipe, plus smoker and campfire ones when the result is food.

names.description: Subtype display names. Two or more split the definition into one block per name, and metadata keys in drops, bounds and textures pick the subtype.

texFile.description: Spritesheet file name, when the texture is given flat rather than in tex.

icon.description: Spritesheet index, when the texture is given flat rather than in tex.

renderType.description: How to draw it: cross (or flower, billboard, sapling), crop (or crops), and anything else is a cube. Defaults to cross for bush, plant and sapling, crop for crop, and a cube otherwise.

material.description: Legacy 1.6 material, which sets the map colour and, without stepSound, the sound.

stepSound.description: Sound group: stone, wood, gravel, grass, metal, glass, cloth, sand, snow, ladder, anvil.

textureBase.description: Reuse another block's textures for the faces this one does not draw, e.g. "crops". Only a cube-shaped renderType has faces to fill.

growsOn.description: Blocks this may be planted on, e.g. "farmland,dirt,grass". A basic block reads it only when walkthroughable.

growthRate.description: Percentage of the baseline growth speed, 100 when absent; higher is faster.

maxGrowth.description: Highest growth stage, or ripening stage.

fruit.description: What a ripe bush yields when picked, written like drops and read at its last growth stage; drops is then what breaking it leaves. A bush without it is never picked.

growthHeight.description: How many blocks tall it grows.

fertilisable.description: Whether bone meal works on it.

walkthroughable.description: No collision box. A basic block declaring it is vegetation, and needs a growsOn block beneath it.

becomesWhenDestroyed.description: Block left in place after this one is broken.

growsInto.description: A sapling: the tree it becomes. A ripening block: the block it becomes once ripe.

inheritMeta.description: With names, each subtype grows the matching subtype of growsInto rather than the first.

fruit.description: What a ripe leaf yields when picked, written like drops. A tree without it bears nothing.

maxGrowth.description: Highest ripeness stage of a leaf; 1 when absent, so a leaf is bare or ripe.

growthRate.description: Percentage of the baseline ripening speed, 100 when absent.

fertilisable.description: Whether bone meal ripens a leaf.

trunkMeta.description: Metadata of the log block, one per subtype when the tree declares names.

shape.description: Silhouette: oak (the default), conifer (or pine), or tall.

grows.description: The fruit block it grows beside. A stem without one is not registered.

plantType.description: Where it may be planted, when it declares no growsOn: crop, plains, desert, beach, cave, water, nether.

ingredients.description: What may go in the pot as a food, as an alias.

flavourings.description: What may season the pot, as an alias.

proteins.description: What may go in the pot as a protein, as an alias.

then.description: A 2013 archetype this build does not register: the definition is skipped and every property it declares is reported as unread.

itemSection.description: Items, keyed by the name other definitions refer to them by.

itemType.description: The archetype that decides how the item behaves. Anything not listed needs another mod to register it.

item.description: An item. The properties below apply to every archetype the engine registers; the allOf branches add the ones each archetype reads, keyed on the lower-case type (no type means basic). A property outside its archetype's branches is still accepted, and the engine reports it as unread.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the key.

override.description: Replace an existing item, named by reference, with this definition. Only a tool or a sword can override.

texFile.description: Spritesheet file name under the pack's textures/ directory.

textureBase.description: Not read for items, which draw only their own sprite.

fuel.description: Burn time in ticks when used as furnace fuel.

container.description: The item left behind after crafting with this one, and after eating it, e.g. "bowl".

cooked.description: The item this smelts into: a furnace recipe, plus smoker and campfire ones when the result is food.

smeltsInto.description: Never read; use cooked or a smelt recipe instead.

names.description: Subtype display names. Two or more split the definition into one item per name, and metadata keys pick the subtype.

potionEffect.description: Effect applied on eating, uniform or keyed by subtype.

drops.description: What you are left holding after eating, written like a block's drops. Only a single item that always drops is carried, and container takes precedence.

growsInto.description: The block planted. Without one the seed is a plain item.

inheritMeta.description: With names, each subtype plants the matching subtype of growsInto rather than the first.

damage.description: Attack damage, which a tool adds to its material's bonus. Read as a whole number.

efficiency.description: Mining speed against blocksEffective. Defaults to the material's.

material.description: Tier, which sets durability, enchantability, repair item and damage bonus: wood, stone, copper, iron, gold, diamond, netherite.

canHarvest.description: Blocks that drop only when broken with it. Without one, it harvests what it is effective against.

cannotHarvest.description: Blocks that never drop when broken with it.

transforms.description: Block it right-clicks to the block that becomes.

canBlock.description: Can be raised to block. Default true.

canCut.description: Blocks it cuts quickly and harvests. Defaults to cobweb.

ammoConsumed.description: Whether firing uses up the ammo.

ammoless.description: Fires with no ammo at all.

semiautomatic.description: Fires on click rather than on release.

power.description: Levels of Power added to whatever the bow is enchanted with. Read as a whole number.

punch.description: Levels of Punch added to whatever the bow is enchanted with.

flame.description: Any value above zero sets every arrow alight, as Flame does. Not a duration.

destroyChance.description: Percent chance of breaking on use. Default 66.

blocks.description: Block it is used on, to what that block then yields. First matching entry wins.

then.description: A 2013 archetype this build does not register: the definition is skipped and every property it declares is reported as unread.

recipeSection.description: Recipes, keyed by product unless the recipe names one. A key of "cull" removes recipes instead.

oneOf.description: Shapeless. The key is the product, optionally with a count ("cornKernels:2"), and the value is the ingredient list.

product.description: What is made. Defaults to the key.

content.description: Ingredients, comma-separated. With a pattern, one per letter in order of first appearance.

pattern.description: Shaped: rows separated by commas, one letter per ingredient and a space for empty, e.g. "X X, X , F ".

cull.description: Remove every recipe producing these items.

spawnSection.description: World generation rules, keyed by the block placed unless the rule names one.

block.description: Block to place. Defaults to the key.

spawnsOn.description: Blocks it may stand on, e.g. "grass,dirt".

spawnsNear.description: Blocks that must be within nearDistance.

clump.description: Place the cluster together rather than scattered.

biomes.description: Biome names, comma-separated. Empty means everywhere. A name prefixed with ! is left out, as in "forest,!birchforest".

aliasSection.description: Named groups of items, referred to elsewhere as "$name". Aliases with the same name across files merge.
